review: Authored fresh; no chorus field (the repeated vocative lines are printed lines, not a chorus). מָשִׁיחִי for مسيحي per the settled h0199/h0232 usage; here it is the vocative "O Christian". הֶבֶל הֶבֶל for سراب سراب (Ecclesiastes register). 1:2/1:6, 2:2/2:6 and 3:2/3:6 repeat verbatim per the Arabic. 3:4 בַּצְּלָב typed with Hebrew letters only.
